### Daily Disciples Devotional - January 12
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-devotional-january-12-11564680.html
Passage: Genesis 26:34-35
Points:
- Difficult people and conflicting relationships can become a constant source of mental grief and frustration.
- God allows challenging individuals into our lives to teach us genuine mercy, kindness, and unselfish love.
- Loving difficult people is impossible in our own strength and requires daily dependence on the Holy Spirit.
- Although we cannot force the other person to change, God can transform our own hearts and attitudes.
- Proactively praying before interacting with difficult people helps prevent us from reacting in the flesh.
